OpenAI Appoints Prabhjeet Singh as India Managing Director

OpenAI has announced a significant development for its operations in India, appointing Prabhjeet Singh as the new Managing Director for the region. Singh previously served as a regional chief at Uber. This appointment marks a notable step for OpenAI's presence and strategy within the Indian market.
